title: Diagnose and document the two silver_procurement quality checks that fail on every pipeline run
description:
The latest Scheduled run (2026-08-05T20:37:01) recorded three non-pass rows in gold_quality_history, two of them genuine 'fail': oem_lh.silver_procurement / dq_data_type_consistency = 75.0 (fail) and oem_lh.silver_procurement / dq_business_rule_validation = 81.82 (fail). Both are ADVISORY (absent from BLOCKING_CHECKS) so the gate correctly did not raise — but neither is explained anywhere. 'data_type_consistency' appears in ZERO files under docs/ (positive control: 'business_rule_validation' IS present in docs/data_quality_framework.md, so the probe works).

data_quality_checks.Notebook declares 8 expected types for silver_procurement (date:date, materialname:string, suppliername:string, quantity:decimal, unit:string, unitpriceeur:decimal, headquarterscountry:string, productioncountry:string); 75.0 means 2 of 8 mismatch — plausibly the two decimal columns landing as a different numeric type through the Copy activity, BUT THAT MUST BE MEASURED, NOT ASSUMED.

Determine the mismatching columns and the failing business rules, then EITHER fix the cast in bronze_to_silver OR record the divergence as accepted in docs/data_quality_framework.md with a rationale. Do NOT silence the check (rules/agents.md § Root Cause Over Symptom).

The third non-pass row — bronze_procurement_transactional / dq_date_range_validation = 0.0 (warning, breach_flag true) — is expected by design per § Data Architecture line 636 (bronze holds the source's raw day/year-transposed dates), but confirm that expectation is written somewhere a reader will find it.
acceptanceCriteria: The exact mismatching columns behind data_type_consistency = 75.0 are identified by measurement, not inference.
The failing business rules behind business_rule_validation = 81.82 are identified.
Each is either FIXED at source in bronze_to_silver, or documented as accepted in docs/data_quality_framework.md with an explicit rationale — not suppressed, not removed from the check set.
The expected bronze date_range_validation = 0.0 warning is documented where a reader encountering it will find it.
A pipeline run after the change shows the intended outcome (either the checks pass, or they fail with documented acceptance).
notes: CREATED 2026-08-05 by phase-level verification — THE CLEAREST GAP 74 CONSECUTIVE PER-TASK PASSES MISSED.
Root cause of the miss: per-task verification scope is bounded by files_affected, so a defect visible only in the cross-run aggregate of gold_quality_history had no owner until phase level.
Advisory, not blocking — the DQ gate behaved correctly. This is about undocumented persistent failure, not a broken gate.
